y0d4d8dc5509.add: - **Graphs of motion:** slope of a **distance–time** graph = **speed**; slope of a **velocity–time** graph = **acceleration**; area under a v–t graph = distance.

ya7ce42376fd.add: - **Force = rate of change of momentum** (Newton's 2nd law, F = ma); **impulse** = force × time = change in momentum.

ye325883e894.add: - **Newton's laws:** 1st – inertia (rest/uniform motion unless a net force acts); **2nd – rate of change of momentum ∝ net force, in its direction**; 3rd – action = reaction.

y85cd85878cc.add: - **Plane mirror image:** virtual, erect, **same size**, laterally inverted, as far behind as the object is in front; focal length **infinite**.

y4773e1a33f8.add: - **Plane mirror image = virtual, erect and laterally inverted** (same size; focal length infinite, not zero).

yfb1a449c4af.add: - **Convex mirror:** image always **virtual, erect, diminished** (point-sized for a far object) – wide field of view.

yc6e0446e704.add: - A mirror that always shows you **smaller** than you are = **convex mirror**.

y28bae473412.add: - **Dentist's mirror = concave** – teeth within focus give an erect, **magnified** image.

yef2f08e039a.add: - **Rear-view (convex) mirror:** image **virtual, erect and smaller** – wider field of view, so all three reasons hold.

y5f03c17eb18.add: - Only a **concave mirror** can give an **enlarged** and an **inverted (real)** image; convex always diminished-erect, plane always same size.

y1d203901fe1.add: - **Headlight:** bulb at the **focus** of a concave mirror → reflected rays go out as a **parallel beam**.

y5cb06673ca5.add: - "**Objects in mirror are closer than they appear**" – printed on **convex** rear-view mirrors (diminished image looks farther).

yb486d2cfd16.add: - **Concave mirror, object at C** → image **at C**, real, inverted, same size; object between F and C → beyond C, real, magnified.

y6c1a220f801.add: - **Concave mirror, object between P and F** → image **behind the mirror, virtual, erect, enlarged**; object at F → image at infinity.

yc2051250c09.add: - Object between **pole and focus** of a concave mirror → image **behind the mirror**.

y2e76e11778a.add: - "Image at **infinity**" is true only when the object is **at F** of a concave mirror, not between P and F.

y7d4ed724c8c.add: - f = 16 cm → C at 32 cm; object moved to 24 cm (**between F and C**) → image **real and magnified** beyond C.
